about_the_game:
Welcome to Tradie Tapper

The Aussie-built idle game where you tap, hire, and rebirth your way to tradie stardom.

Start from a bare dirt lot and build your empire one job site at a time. Hire sparkies, plumbers, roofers and more, each tradie adding to your passive income machine. Upgrade their gear, smash milestones, and take on brutally scaled rebirth contracts as you climb the ranks.

Whether you're smashing tinnies or topping leaderboards, one thing’s for sure: the grind never stops.

Features

  • Tap to earn coins and upgrade your tradie crew

  • Hire Electricians, Builders, Apprentices, and more

  • 20+ unique backgrounds from trailer parks to disaster zones

  • Rebirth system with randomized mutators and scaling challenge

  • Skill tree integration for long-term progression

  • Steam leaderboards and achievement tracking

  • Offline support with anti-cheat protections

  • Built with pixel charm, Aussie humour, and a relentless pace

Aussie-made. Meme-fueled. Built for the grind.

Join us in Early Access and help shape the future of Tradie Tapper, one contract at a time.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Dual-core 2.0 GHz
  • Memory: 2048 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 3000 or better
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated
  • Additional Notes: Game requires an internet connection to sync progress and access leaderboards.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Quad-core 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 4096 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Dedicated GPU with 1GB VRAM
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: Integrated or better
  • Additional Notes: Optimized for 60 FPS on most mid-range systems.

short_description: Tap, hire, and rebirth your way to tradie stardom in this Aussie-made idle clicker. Build job sites, collect gear, unlock skill trees, and climb the monthly leaderboards. Whether you're laying bricks or chasing ranks, the grind never stops.
